limitations: Existing clips are correlated and some include overlays; not an independent dataset or object-detection mAP benchmark.
No model prediction was used to create labels.
Frame labels indicate presence of at least one visible bare head, not per-person detection IoU or mAP.
library30 has sparse certain positive frame labels; all other action frames are unknown, so labelled-frame metrics are not whole-video accuracy.
Unknown frames are excluded from binary accuracy; no_person frames are separately identified.
No helmet does not establish construction activity; this experiment isolates PPE detection.
labeling_method: Single Codex visual review of all contact sheets plus selected original-resolution frames. Model predictions were not consulted. Ambiguous people/occlusion retained as unknown.
